title: The 30-second fix for #AI on mobile
description:
AI feels like extra work when it should be effortless.

❌ Your phone's share sheet is the problem. By default, AI apps are buried at the bottom.

✅ Move ChatGPT next to AirDrop on iPhone or pin it to the top on Android.
